B10_acceptance_evidence: Original five-system imported cohort (10 trajectories) uses the existing five-system final receipt; the remaining50 trajectories use source-recorded worker ledgers. Missing per-job receipt hashes stay blank and are not fabricated.
B50_curves: Initial fresh observer verified each complete RPC discovery curve equals result curve. Export then reread only the small immutable result JSON with the already verified SHA; raw_RPC SHA is source-bound artifact metadata in that envelope, not an additional full-RPC rehash.

execution_source_applicability.all30_frozen_made_all30_runner.py: The50 new all30 B10 extension jobs. It is not asserted to have executed the original two/five-system jobs.
execution_source_applicability.original_core_and_five_system_jobs: Their original scope fingerprints and raw result hashes remain authoritative; later inclusion does not relabel their executing source.
execution_source_applicability.sweep_frozen_made_budget_runner.py: New B30/B50 sweep jobs only. It is not asserted to have executed any B10 historical job.

metrics: SUN final count; mSUN=SUN/B; AUDC=2*trapezoidal_integral(SUN vs query)/B^2 including(0,0). Variance is sample variance ddof1 across systems at seed1; not variation across training/evaluation seeds.
path_policy: All raw paths are relative to the original experiment project, not files promised in this repository. Original byte hashes are distinct from derived export hashes. Private actor/host/auth/runtime configurations and raw RPC bodies are omitted.
